headline: Berkshire Hathaway issued ¥265.0B yen and $7.0B USD senior notes across 7 tranches.
summary: Berkshire Hathaway completed a multi-currency senior notes offering totaling ¥265B and $7B across 7 tranches to fund general corporate purposes.
keyHighlights: Proceeds to be used for general corporate purposes.
Joint book-runners include Mizuho, BofA, and Goldman Sachs.
financialImpact: Adds approximately $8.7B (USD-equivalent) of long-term debt to the balance sheet.
